title: Noninvasive Ventilation Facemasks Favoring Carbon Dioxide Washout
official: Physiological Effects of Novel Noninvasive Ventilation Facemasks Favoring Carbon Dioxide Washout in Patients With Hypercapnic Respiratory Failure
summary: The objective of this randomized cross-over trial is to assess the physiological effects of three different facemasks for noninvasive ventilation (Nivairo, Visairo, Optiniv) in patients with acute hypercapnic respiratory failure
